name: What is the difference between a design-build firm and hiring an architect and contractor separately?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a design-build firm and hiring an architect and contractor separately?

acceptedAnswer.text: A design-build firm, like Opus Builders, offers a streamlined approach where a single entity manages both the architectural design and construction phases of your family room addition. This fosters better communication, fewer change orders, and often a more efficient timeline and budget control. When hiring an architect and contractor separately, you manage two distinct contracts and relationships, which can sometimes lead to coordination challenges or delays. Design-build provides a unified team committed to a single vision, from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: A design-build firm manages both design and construction under one contract, offering streamlined communication and efficiency, unlike separate architect and contractor hiring.
